inlineImageAndParagraph.text: ICSI Verification confirms if a Company Secretary is a registered, active member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI). Decentro's API instantly validates CS credentials by querying their unique ICSI membership number against the official registry, returning name, membership type, and active status in real time, without manual effort or document uploads for compliant professional onboarding.

items.description: Pass the ICSI membership/registration number (e.g., ACS12345 or FCS67890) to initiate the verification. This single input triggers the real-time lookup against the official ICSI registry for instant validation.
Decentro queries the official ICSI member database in real time. This direct connection ensures the authenticity and active status of the professional, avoiding stale data.
Fetch the member's name, membership grade, active status, and regional chapter. Receive a structured response with full member data and verification status for confident decision-making.
